note: Generated by X4MP.Protocol.Tests GoldenVectors (set X4MP_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 and run dotnet test to regenerate). Do not edit.

kinds.frame: complete TCP frame (8-byte header + FlatBuffers payload); decode payload with the table for msgType; fields = canonical dump of every decoded field (see CanonicalFields.cs); re-encode must reproduce the frame semantically
kinds.replication-entries: raw Replication.entries bytes (protocol.md 10.2); decode all entries and re-encode byte-identically
kinds.datagram: complete UDP datagram (24-byte header + padded sub-messages)
kinds.reject-frame: bytes that must be rejected as a frame stream; expect = C# ViolationCode name
kinds.reject-replication-entries: entries bytes that must be rejected when decoded with entryCount
kinds.reject-datagram: bytes that must be rejected as a datagram header/sub-message list

quantize.rounding: half away from zero, computed in IEEE double (C++: std::llround)
quantize.rotation: i16 = (int16)(llround(radians * 32768/pi)), modulo-2^16 wrap; pi and -pi both give -32768
quantize.velocity: i16 = round(mps * 4), or round(mps / 4) when coarse
